title: KillSec ransomware mastermind is 16 years old, DarkReading reports
content_md:
Cybersecurity news share (posted with multilingual hashtags): DarkReading reports that the suspected mastermind of the KillSec ransomware operation is 16 years old, in the wake of the international takedown of the group's infrastructure.

Original article: https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/killsec-ransomware-mastermind-16-year-old
